text:
Predicates:
LargestCity(x, y) ::: x is the largest city in y.
City(x) ::: x is a city.
CapitalOf(x, y) ::: x is the capital of y.
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
HostEvent(x, y) ::: x hosted event y.
HasUniversities(x, n) ::: x has n universities.
RankAmong(x, n, y) ::: x ranks n-th among y.
University(x) ::: x is a university.
Country(x) ::: x is a country.
Population(x, y) ::: population of x is y.
LargestPopulation(y) ::: y is the most populous country.
LargestCityInCountry(x, y) ::: x is the largest city in country y.
SecondLargestCityInCountry(x, y) ::: x is the second largest city in country y.

Premises:
City(Beijing) ::: Beijing is a city.
CapitalOf(Beijing, PRC) ::: Beijing is the capital of the People's Republic of China.
LocatedIn(Beijing, NorthernChina) ::: Beijing is located in Northern China.
HostEvent(Beijing, Summer2008) ::: Beijing hosted the 2008 Summer Olympics.
HostEvent(Beijing, Paralympics2008) ::: Beijing hosted the 2008 Summer Paralympics.
HostEvent(Beijing, SummerOlympics) ::: Beijing has hosted the Summer Olympics.
HostEvent(Beijing, WinterOlympics) ::: Beijing has hosted the Winter Olympics.
HostEvent(Beijing, SummerParalympics) ::: Beijing has hosted the Summer Paralympics.
HostEvent(Beijing, WinterParalympics) ::: Beijing has hosted the Winter Paralympics.
HasUniversities(Beijing, 91) ::: Beijing has 91 universities.
RankAmongUniversities(Beijing, n, world) ::: There are rankings n among universities in Beijing in the world.
LargestPopulation(wolrd) ::: The world's most populous nation.
Population(China, p) ::: Population of China is p.
LargestCityInCountry(Beijing, China) ::: Beijing is the largest city in China.
SecondLargestCityInCountry(x, China) ::: x is the second largest city in China.

Conclusion:
¬SecondLargestCityInCountry(Beijing, China) ::: Beijing is not the second largest Chinese city.
